hypothesis: The existing upstream PGO/LTO build is a new arithmetic family; same-machine throughput gains may justify its bounded compressed-size difference.

prerequisite.observed: PGO 256 KiB real round trip passed; size 20954B, coding 166.987498s, bytes changed against the old golden. The original neutral comparison remains stopped.

build_policy: Reuse these two built binaries; zero retraining, rebuilding, flag sweeps or prefetch combination.

resource.cpu_affinity: minimum available CPU, inherited by every trial
resource.wall_envelope_policy: One CPU plus a conservative 4320-second wall envelope from first launch bounds CPU usage; explicit inspected resumes retain the same envelope.
resource.timeout_policy: GNU timeout kills each stage process group before the earlier research deadline or wall envelope; remote logs and outputs remain.
resource.admission_estimate: 1.2 times the existing same-size original-trial wall time, plus 60 seconds; only missing encode/decode stages count.

sequence.name: prefix-1m
sequence.purpose: fresh same-machine original then PGO pair

verification: Each trial must pass real encode/decode with the original full stream/vocabulary/dictionary/weights identity and exact restored slice. Original v26 must reproduce its original golden bytes. Save each PGO encoded SHA-256 as the new family golden, its original-golden equality flag, and PGO-minus-v26 encoded-byte delta.
continue_gate: Prefix encode+decode coding seconds improve by >=3% and PGO adds <=16B; otherwise stop-at-screen.
accept_gate: Both samples together improve encode+decode coding seconds by >=3%; q2 speed gain is positive; each sample adds <=16B. Retain-for-long-confirmation only; no automatic long run.
size_budget_context: 16B per 1MiB is roughly 9KB when linearly scaled to the prepared full stream; this is an experimental budget, not an observed full-stream result.
resume: Existing encoded/passed trials are reused by the original batch.py. Failed/deferred/interrupted states require the main Agent to inspect real receipts before explicit --resume-inspected. Preserve all original outputs, profiles, binaries and the old neutral-stop state.
reporting: Report coding and wall time, CPU where emitted, RSS, executable bytes, both candidate golden hashes and per-sample encoded-byte deltas separately. Full S and formal normalized runtime remain full-data measurements.
